name: LangChang translation engine
postCreateCommand: pip install --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu torch==2.4.1 && pip install -r translation-service/requirements.txt
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'cd translation-service && nohup python -m uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 > /tmp/engine.log 2>&1 &'
